name: Tokyo International Exchange Center Plaza Heisei
address: Tokyo 135-8630 Kokusai Kenkyu Koryu Daigaku Mura (International Research and Exchange University Village), 2-2-1 Aomi, Koto-ku
accessSummary: Yurikamome Line, Tokyo International Cruise Terminal Station East Exit: about 3 min walk / Rinkai Line, Tokyo Teleport Station Exit B: about 15 min walk
hours: Available 9:00-21:00. Open all year except the year-end and New Year holidays (Dec 29-Jan 3) (may close for inspection, repairs, etc.). Counter visits and phone inquiries 9:00-18:00
notice: Use is mainly for meetings and events related to international exchange, education, academia and culture. Political and religious groups, etc. are subject to restrictions on use. Transfer or subletting of rights is prohibited (Terms of Use).

rooms.name: International Conference Hall
rooms.note: 479 seats (279 on the 1F are movable, 200 on the 2F are fixed). Theater layout: 418 seats (279 on the 1F, 139 on the 2F). Simultaneous interpretation system supports up to 6 languages (6 booths). Organizer's office, waiting room and grand piano are available.

rooms.name: Media Hall
rooms.note: Simultaneous interpretation system supports up to 3 languages (3 booths). Theater layout is standard; any other layout is set up by the organizer. Waiting room available.

rooms.name: Main Foyer
rooms.note: Can be used freely as a rest area when the International Conference Hall or Media Hall is in use.

rooms.name: Conference Room 1
rooms.note: Equipped with a 100-inch screen, projector, etc.

rooms.name: Conference Room 4
rooms.note: Conference Rooms 4 and 5 can be combined and used as one room.

rooms.name: Conference Room 5
rooms.note: Conference Rooms 4 and 5 can be combined and used as one room.

ops.prevDaySetup: For setup up to the day before the event only, the facility usage fee is half price (utility charges such as electricity and water are added in full). Usage time includes setup and cleanup time.
ops.loadingHours: When bringing in equipment, fixtures or food and drink from outside, discuss the route, number of vehicles, etc. with the facility in advance for load-in and load-out. Necessary protective covering must be installed; if the prescribed protection is not accepted, work may be ordered to stop. Bring your own hand trucks. Parcels such as courier deliveries are in principle not accepted.
ops.parking: There is a paid parking lot for participants and visitors under Plaza Heisei. The entrance is on the front side of Plaza Heisei (the Miraikan side). It is managed and operated by Times24 Co., Ltd.
ops.waitingRooms: The International Conference Hall comes with an organizer's office and a waiting room, and the Media Hall comes with a waiting room.
ops.catering: Consult the facility in advance before bringing in equipment, fixtures, or food and drink from outside. If food or drink is brought in, you must clean up afterward. Any trash generated must be taken home (a separate disposal fee applies if the facility handles it).
